scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: On 19 March 1882, construction of Sagrada Família began under the architect Francisco de Paula del Villar.
scenes.quote: On 19 March 1882, construction of Sagrada Família began under the architect Francisco de Paula del Villar.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: In 1883, when Villar resigned, Gaudí took over as chief architect, transforming the project with his architectural and engineering style, combining Gothic and curvilinear Art Nouveau forms.
scenes.quote: In 1883, when Villar resigned, Gaudí took over as chief architect, transforming the project with his architectural and engineering style, combining Gothic and curvilinear Art Nouveau forms.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: At the time of his death in 1926, less than a quarter of the project was complete.
scenes.quote: At the time of his death in 1926, less than a quarter of the project was complete.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: In July 1936, anarchists from the Iberian Anarchist Federation (Federación Anarquista Ibérica, or FAI) set fire to the crypt and broke their way into the workshop, partially destroying Gaudí's original plans.
scenes.quote: In July 1936, anarchists from the Iberian Anarchist Federation (Federación Anarquista Ibérica, or FAI) set fire to the crypt and broke their way into the workshop, partially destroying Gaudí's original plans.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: In 2005, parts of the Sagrada Família (Nativity façade and Crypt) were declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site, under "Works of Antoni Gaudí".
scenes.quote: In 2005, parts of the Sagrada Família (Nativity façade and Crypt) were declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site, under "Works of Antoni Gaudí".

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: On 7 November 2010, Pope Benedict XVI consecrated the church and proclaimed it a basilica.
scenes.quote: On 7 November 2010, Pope Benedict XVI consecrated the church and proclaimed it a basilica.
